symptom: `alter settings webui (OptimizedClient: 'Yes')` → `Error: unknown settings section: webui (expected model, configuration, constant, LANGUAGE, or workflows)`; `show settings` printed `Web UI Settings | OptimizedClient: Yes` but `describe settings` had no Web UI statement, so the setting could be neither set nor round-tripped from MDL
cause: Read-only half-feature: the reader filled model.WebUISettings and listSettings printed it, but the executor had no `webui` section and UpdateProjectSettings passed the Forms$WebUIProjectSettingsPart through as read — so an executor case alone would have printed "Updated webui settings" and written nothing (the backend test failed with `stored UseOptimizedClient = "Yes", want No` until the overlay case existed)
file: mdl/executor/cmd_settings.go (alterSettings `webui` case, storedWebUISettings, useOptimizedClientValues, describeSettings); mdl/settingsoverlay/settingsoverlay.go (SetWebUISettings, IsWebUIPart); mdl/backend/modelsdk/settings_write.go (UpdateProjectSettings Web UI case); mdl/executor/validate_settings.go (typedSettingsKeys webui); tests mdl/executor/cmd_settings_webui_test.go, mdl/backend/modelsdk/settings_write_webui_test.go, mdl/settingsoverlay/webui_settings_test.go
insight: A settings section that `show` can display is not one that can be written: UpdateProjectSettings only overlays the parts it has a case for and passes every other part through byte-for-byte, so adding an alter section needs a backend case too, and only a test on the stored BSON tells the two apart (an executor test with a mock backend passes either way). Storage name is Forms$WebUIProjectSettingsPart, not Settings$ (measured on 11.6.6, 11.13.0, 11.14.0 fixtures); Model SDK says useOptimizedClient introduced 9.10.0 with no per-member gates, so the overlay is presence-gated and exec refuses a part without it. Measured on a blank 11.14.0 app: `mx check` = 0 errors after `webui No` + ExtraJvmParameters, and 0 errors with 'React' forced into UseOptimizedClient — mxbuild does not catch a non-member, so the settingsEnum refusal (MDL-SET03) is load-bearing. Key spelled `OptimizedClient` to match what `list settings` prints and the create-page skill / run-local docs already point at
